race.comment: ZAWADI (8) turned spotting a big start finishing sixth (20.06) last time in a Rank Limit - Grade 5 at this track. Has a good record at this journey. Tough to beat if on-song. KING PLUM (3) placed two back in a Grade 5 at Ballarat then backed that up with a third (19.81) over 350m at this track last time. Can improve sharply here. SUMMER HAIL (1) turned in a solid run last start over 350m at this track finishing 4th and beaten only 4.5 lengths (19.96). Solid record here at the distance winning eight races. Has ability and a bold showing is expected. SUAVE (2) missed the placings here most recently but can sneak into the finish with the right run.
